changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW marketplace_estate_eligibility WITH (security_barrier = true) AS SELECT e.id AS estate_id, e.published AS published, (o.verification_state = 'VERIFIED') AS tenant_verified, o.marketplace_publishing AS tenant_entitled, (o.status = 'ACTIVE') AS tenant_active, -- CASE short-circuits, so the conflict function — the only -- expensive term — runs last, and only for estates that -- already pass every cheap condition. CASE WHEN e.published AND o.verification_state = 'VERIFIED' AND o.marketplace_publishing AND o.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (e.fees_declared_at IS NOT NULL OR e.fees_declaration_exempt) AND (e.fees_declaration_exempt OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM estate_refund_terms rt WHERE rt.estate_id = e.id AND rt.deleted = false)) AND e.footprint IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plots p WHERE p.estate_id = e.id AND p.deleted = false) AND (e.photo_requirement_exempt OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM estate_photos ph WHERE ph.estate_id = e.id AND ph.deleted = false)) THEN (SELECT s.blocking_count FROM landvault_estate_conflict_summary(e.id) s) = 0 ELSE false END AS eligible, -- Declaring an EMPTY schedule counts: an estate with no -- extra charges may list, but by saying so. Silence does -- not, and the two are different facts. (e.fees_declared_at IS NOT NULL OR e.fees_declaration_exempt) AS fees_declared, -- RF-4: a developer who will not state what a buyer gets -- back does not get a listing. Its own boolean beside the -- others so the publish endpoint can name which one failed. (e.fees_declaration_exempt OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM estate_refund_terms rt WHERE rt.estate_id = e.id AND rt.deleted = false)) AS refund_terms_declared, -- BG-1: an estate with no boundary is invisible to conflict -- detection, so listing without one would be a way around -- it. No exemption for estates already published: an -- exempt boundary-less listing is exactly the hole. (e.footprint IS NOT NULL) AS has_boundary, -- An estate with nothing to sell is not a listing. ANY live -- plot counts, whatever its status: requiring an AVAILABLE -- one would pull a sold-out estate off the marketplace and -- make one flicker during checkout holds, revealing exactly -- the sales velocity marketplace_plots collapses statuses to -- hide. EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plots p WHERE p.estate_id = e.id AND p.deleted = false) AS has_plots, -- A buyer should see what they are buying into. Estates -- already published when this shipped are exempt and report -- true, like fees_declared. (e.photo_requirement_exempt OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM estate_photos ph WHERE ph.estate_id = e.id AND ph.deleted = false)) AS has_photo FROM estates e JOIN organizations o ON o.id = e.tenant_id AND o.deleted = false WHERE e.deleted = false;

changeSet.sql: DROP VIEW marketplace_listings; CREATE VIEW marketplace_listings WITH (security_barrier = true) AS SELECT e.id AS estate_id, e.name AS name, e.area AS area, e.city AS city, e.state AS state, e.description AS description, e.intent AS intent, e.corner_premium_pct AS corner_premium_pct, e.published_at AS published_at, e.footprint AS footprint, t.title_type AS title_type, b.name AS branch_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(o.trading_name), ''), o.registered_name) AS company_name, v.last_verified_at AS last_verified_at, ft.price AS from_price, ft.currency AS from_price_currency, ft.price_per_sqm AS from_price_per_sqm, sz.min_size_sqm AS min_size_sqm, sz.max_size_sqm AS max_size_sqm, COALESCE(pr.plots_remaining, 0) AS plots_remaining, -- The branch office, so a buyer can visit or call the people -- they would actually deal with. Published deliberately: the -- portal tells developers these appear on their listings. b.street AS branch_street, b.city AS branch_city, b.state AS branch_state, b.phone AS branch_phone, b.email AS branch_email, -- The cover photo's stored file. The marketplace module asks -- storage for its public URL, so the address is built in one -- place. Null when the estate has no photo (an exempt one). cv.file_id AS cover_file_id FROM marketplace_estate_eligibility el JOIN estates e ON e.id = el.estate_id JOIN organizations o ON o.id = e.tenant_id LEFT JOIN branches b ON b.id = e.branch_id AND b.deleted = false LEFT JOIN estate_titles t ON t.estate_id = e.id AND t.deleted = false -- The most recent check that actually came back VERIFIED. Never a -- pending or not_checked one: absent verification stays absent. LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT max(c.last_verified_at) AS last_verified_at FROM estate_verification_checks c WHERE c.estate_id = e.id AND c.deleted = false AND c.status = 'VERIFIED' ) v ON true -- "From" price: the cheapest tier that still has a plot for sale, -- falling back to the cheapest tier overall when everything is -- sold (the frontend's fromPrice() rule). The tier's own base -- price: a corner premium only ever raises it. LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT pt.price, pt.currency, CASE WHEN pt.tier_type = 'LAND_SIZE' AND pt.size_sqm > 0 THEN round(pt.price / pt.size_sqm, 2) END AS price_per_sqm FROM price_tiers pt WHERE pt.estate_id = e.id AND pt.deleted = false ORDER BY EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM plots p WHERE p.price_tier_id = pt.id AND p.deleted = false AND p.status IN ('AVAILABLE_DEV', 'AVAILABLE_INV') ) DESC, pt.price ASC LIMIT 1 ) ft ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT min(pt.size_sqm) AS min_size_sqm, max(pt.size_sqm) AS max_size_sqm FROM price_tiers pt WHERE pt.estate_id = e.id AND pt.deleted = false AND pt.tier_type = 'LAND_SIZE' ) sz ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS plots_remaining FROM plots p WHERE p.estate_id = e.id AND p.deleted = false AND p.status IN ('AVAILABLE_DEV', 'AVAILABLE_INV') ) pr ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT ph.file_id FROM estate_photos ph JOIN stored_files f ON f.id = ph.file_id WHERE ph.estate_id = e.id AND ph.deleted = false AND ph.cover AND f.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND f.status = 'READY' ) cv ON true WHERE el.eligible; REVOKE ALL ON marketplace_listings FROM ${appDbUsername}; GRANT SELECT ON marketplace_listings TO ${appDbUsername};

changeSet.sql: CREATE VIEW marketplace_estate_photos WITH (security_barrier = true) AS SELECT ph.id AS photo_id, ph.estate_id AS estate_id, ph.file_id AS file_id, ph.caption AS caption, ph.position AS position, ph.cover AS cover FROM marketplace_estate_eligibility el JOIN estate_photos ph ON ph.estate_id = el.estate_id AND ph.deleted = false JOIN stored_files f ON f.id = ph.file_id AND f.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND f.status = 'READY' WHERE el.eligible; REVOKE ALL ON marketplace_estate_photos FROM ${appDbUsername}; GRANT SELECT ON marketplace_estate_photos TO ${appDbUsername};
